# Kolvind Watchtower Web

The phone page for Kolvind's Watchtower: the ideas board, the morning test tour, and 🤖 (pick a branch, Update & install,
run the robot, copy the test log).

This page holds **no data**. It talks to the private repo Troos88/warmth-vst through the GitHub API with a token that
stays in your browser only, and signs robot requests with the pairing code from `Mobilroboten.bat` (also only in your browser).

**Do not edit index.html here.** The source is `tools/watchtower_web/index.html` in warmth-vst; copy it here after a change.
